scope: Official-source research and original archive inspection only; no source conversion, GPU, catalogue edits or acceptance claims.

shortlist.title: Forest Monster
shortlist.author: Čestmír Dammer (CDmir), TinyWorlds

previewEvidence.method: Inspected official static author preview in browser, no 3D rendering
previewEvidence.observation: Layered mossy rock back, integrated tree canopy, barky arms/chest and recessed elemental face. Complete authored body; no horns or animal-head graft.

shortlist.rigEvidence: Archive includes forest-monster-final.blend. Licenses.txt explicitly lists Idle0–190, Walk0–40, melee hold0–50, melee0–30 with strike10–15, Dying0–35. Actions not yet decoded.
shortlist.licenseEvidence: Current archive Licenses.txt says CC0. Official author Sept3 2015 comment says former noncommercial tree texture replaced and all current contents CC0. Current archive contains tree.png/tree-norm.png/tree-spec.png and five forest textures.
shortlist.materials: Original diffuse, normal, AO and specular PNGs preserved.
shortlist.conversionCaveat: Requires Blender-compatible reader; no Blender executable found in PATH or Downloads/.cache search.

shortlist.title: Earth Elemental / Golem
shortlist.author: piacenti

previewEvidence.method: Inspected official static author preview in browser, no 3D rendering
previewEvidence.observation: Hunched continuous craggy rock body, recessed integrated head/eyes, heavy curved forearms and broad feet. Detailed mottled stone texture; no horns or head graft.

shortlist.rigEvidence: Author states two variants and10animations. Both extracted ASCII FBX contain limb skeleton, deformers and15 Take labels including DefaultTake and generically named metarig actions. Unity clip metadata remains intact; mapping not yet decoded.
shortlist.licenseEvidence: Official author upload labels CC-BY3.0; original source HTML retained in source cache.
shortlist.materials: Two original diffuse PNGs, two normal PNGs, Unity materials and prefab metadata preserved.
shortlist.conversionCaveat: FBX6.1ASCII authored by Blender exporter. Modern Blender FBX importer may reject ASCII; mainzip has no blend despite author comment about later blend upload. No current supplement link found.

reserve.title: Swamp Limule
reserve.author: CDmir and TinyWorlds

previewEvidence.method: Inspected official static author preview in browser, no 3D rendering
previewEvidence.observation: Natural horseshoe crab profile with weathered textured shell and long anatomical tail. Strong wholebody identity; top preview hides legs so gait and underside quality unresolved.

reserve.rigEvidence: Author says rigged and animated with diffuse/normal packed inside blend. Not downloaded or decoded.

excluded.reason: Actual preview flat wedge face, straight cylinder legs and simple glossy shell repeat rejected toy fidelity despite normalmap and seven motions.
Actual preview spiked alien carapace and dinosaur jaw conflict with non-demonic direction. Share-alike is also outside preferred CC0/plainCCBY licenses.
Actual preview coarse cutout eyes, angular stump and thin straight limbs. Not convincing fidelity improvement; only Idle/Walk/Run/two attacks stated.
